end.summary: Practised physical and chemical changes using ghee, paper, poster, sparkler, ice, milk and curd.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised using evidence of whether a new substance forms, rather than relying only on reversibility. They correctly classified melting ghee, cutting paper or a poster, burning a sparkler, and later recognised that curd formation is chemical because new properties form; the curd mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Ananya to sort five everyday changes into physical or chemical and give one reason for each.

Haan example do, par ekdum simple! Jaise doodh se dahi banta hai na—woh toh main fridge mein rakh doon toh wapas doodh ban jaata hai, isliye wo physical hoga!

Simple example doodh se dahi banna hi hai. Aap keh rahe hain fridge mein rakhne se dahi wapas doodh ban jaata hai; fridge dahi ko thanda karta hai, doodh nahi banata.
